answer: Each AI agent must register by having its secure enclave generate a keypair from a physical unclonable function and then solve a resource-intensive cipher puzzle whose solution is bound to that silicon key; agents are grouped into a staking grove of exactly 32 members that cross-audits attestations every epoch. To forge a sybil identity an attacker must buy a separate enclave chip for each fake agent and burn at least $50 in staking tokens per identity, because the grove slashes any member that fails the hardware attestation quorum.
